source_law.title: Traffic controlled by official traffic-control devices (8)(b)
source_law.text: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].
